ED_Title: The safety of journalists and the issue of impunity
ED_DecisionText: At its 82nd plenary meeting, on 20 May 2026, the General Assembly, on the proposal of Austria, Costa Rica, France Greece and Tunisia (Footnote: A/80/L.51.),11 recalling paragraph 31 of its resolution 80/217 of 18 December 2025, requested the Secretary-General to submit a report to the Assembly at its eighty-second session and to transmit the report to the Human Rights Council at its sixty-seventh session.
